import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NSM = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"

def col_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    letters, row = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    col = 0
    for ch in letters:
        col = col * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return col, row

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall(f"{{{NSM}}}si"):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{{{NSM}}}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
              for s in wbroot.find(f"{{{NSM}}}sheets")]

    relsroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    relmap = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in relsroot}

    print("Sheets:", sheets)
    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        rows = {}
        for c in sroot.iter(f"{{{NSM}}}c"):
            ref = c.get("r")
            if ref is None:
                continue
            col, row = col_to_idx(ref)
            t = c.get("t")
            v = c.find(f"{{{NSM}}}v")
            val = None
            if v is not None:
                val = shared[int(v.text)] if t == "s" else v.text
            else:
                isel = c.find(f"{{{NSM}}}is")
                if isel is not None:
                    val = "".join(tt.text or "" for tt in isel.iter(f"{{{NSM}}}t"))
            rows.setdefault(row, {})[col] = val
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        for r in sorted(rows):
            cells = rows[r]
            line = " | ".join(f"{cells[c]}" for c in sorted(cells))
            print(f"row {r}: {line}")

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import OrderedDict

NSM = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"

def col_to_idx(ref):
    letters, row = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref).groups()
    col = 0
    for ch in letters:
        col = col * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return col, int(row)

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    data = {}
    for c in sroot.iter(f"{{{NSM}}}c"):
        ref = c.get("r")
        col, row = col_to_idx(ref)
        t = c.get("t")
        v = c.find(f"{{{NSM}}}v")
        val = None
        if v is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            isel = c.find(f"{{{NSM}}}is")
            if isel is not None:
                val = "".join(tt.text or "" for tt in isel.iter(f"{{{NSM}}}t"))
        data[(row, col)] = val

# Expenses: rows 11-22, col A=category, col B=item, col C=amount
by_cat = OrderedDict()
total = 0
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = data.get((r, 1))
    amt = data.get((r, 3))
    by_cat.setdefault(cat, 0)
    by_cat[cat] += amt
    total += amt

print("Per-category totals:")
for cat, amt in by_cat.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {amt}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES: {total}")

# Cross-check: formula in C23 is SUM(C11:C22)
print("Formula in C23:", data.get((23, 3)) or "(none cached)")
print("Formula in B25:", data.get((25, 2)) or "(none cached)")
